setting.title: Turns the MCP server on or off. When it is off, the /mcp endpoint, the REST routes and the XML-RPC proxy refuse all requests. Only members of the MCP User group can connect.
setting.help: Enable or disable MCP server access globally

setting.title: Lets browser MCP clients, such as Claude.ai and Gemini, connect after the user logs in to Odoo. API keys work in both cases. When this is off, the /mcp/oauth/* routes and OAuth discovery answer HTTP 404. On by default.
setting.help: Let browser clients sign in with Odoo via OAuth 2.1 (on by default)

setting.title: Comma-separated browser origins that can call /mcp, for example https://app.example.com. When the list is empty, all origins are accepted. When it is set, a request from another origin gets HTTP 403. Native clients, such as Claude Desktop and Cursor, send no Origin header and are always accepted.
setting.help: Restrict browser calls to these Origins (empty = no restriction)

setting.title: Limits the requests per minute of each user on /mcp, the REST routes and the XML-RPC proxy. Each Odoo worker counts on its own, so with several workers a user can make up to (workers x limit) requests. For a strict limit, use a reverse proxy. Off by default.
setting.help: Enforce request limits to prevent API abuse

a.title: Requests per user per minute. Past this number, the server answers HTTP 429 until the minute ends. Pings do not count. Values from 1 to 9 count as 10. Set 0 for no limit. Default: 300.

div.div: Maximum requests per minute per user (0 = unlimited)

setting.title: Comma-separated context keys that a write call through the XML-RPC proxy (/mcp/xmlrpc/object) can send, on top of the built-in keys. A default_ key counts too, for example default_partner_id. A write call with any other key gets fault 403, and the message names the key. Some keys make Odoo skip a business check. For example, check_move_validity lets a journal entry stay unbalanced, and default_state can create a posted journal entry. Add a key only when an integration needs it. Reads and the /mcp endpoint do not change.
setting.help: Context keys that write calls through the XML-RPC proxy can send, on top of the built-in keys (empty = built-in keys only)
setting.div: Always allowed: lang, tz, uid, active_test, allowed_company_ids, bin_size, tracking_disable, mail_create_nolog, mail_create_nosubscribe, mail_notrack

setting.title: Hours that a read_attachment download link stays valid. Anyone with the link can download the file without an Odoo login, and a single link cannot be revoked. Keep it short. The AI client asks for a new link when one expires. Maximum: 1008 hours (42 days). Set 0 to use the default. Default: 1.
setting.help: Validity of read_attachment download links (no login needed)

setting.title: Writes one audit row per MCP call to the MCP log: user, IP address, tool, model, record IDs, duration and errors. The rows store argument names and result sizes, never field values. When this is off, nothing is logged, failed logins included.
setting.help: Keep an audit log of MCP calls (metadata only)

a.title: Number of days to keep MCP log rows. A daily scheduled action deletes older rows. Set 0 to keep all rows. Default: 30.

div.div: Older log rows are deleted every day

block.title: Tool Limits
block.name: mcp_tool_limits_setting_container
block.help: Default and maximum sizes applied to MCP read and batch write tools

setting.title: Number of records that search_records, aggregate_records and list_record_attachments return when the client sends no limit. Default: 25.
setting.help: Records returned when the client does not request a limit

setting.title: Largest number of records that search_records, aggregate_records and list_record_attachments return in one call. A larger limit from the client is reduced to this value. Default: 100.
setting.help: Hard cap on records returned per request

setting.title: Largest number of entries in one create_records or update_records call. The server refuses a larger batch and asks the client to split it. Default: 100.
setting.help: Maximum entries per batch write call (create_records / update_records)

block.title: Output Formatting
block.name: mcp_output_setting_container
block.help: Which fields and related records appear in tool output, and where long text is cut

setting.title: When the client lists no fields, the server picks the most useful fields, up to this number. This keeps the answers short for the AI model. Default: 15.
setting.help: Maximum fields auto-selected when no fields are listed

setting.title: get_record lists up to this many linked records by name. A larger one-to-many or many-to-many field shows a count and a search hint instead. Set 0 to always show the count. Default: 3.
setting.help: Related records shown inline before collapsing to a count

setting.title: search_records, and get_record without named fields (smart defaults or ["__all__"]), show up to this many characters of a text field. A longer value ends with a note that tells the AI to call get_record with the field name, which shows up to 100000 characters. Maximum: 100000. Set 0 to use the default. Default: 2000.
setting.help: Characters of a text field shown before it is cut
